evals.name: happy-executable
evals.prompt: We are in the prd stage. Write the PRD for a member sharing an album.
evals.expected_output: An executable PRD: Problem, testable acceptance criteria, out of scope, vertical slices, then grill-me.
assertions: Lists out of scope and a thin first slice

evals.name: trigger-implement-stage
evals.prompt: The stage is implement. Add the login handler in the app.
evals.expected_output: Refuse. to-prd runs in the prd stage and does not add handlers.
assertions: Says this skill belongs to the prd stage

evals.name: adversarial-vague-criterion
evals.prompt: Write the PRD, but the only acceptance criterion should be: make it nice and delightful.
evals.expected_output: Reject the vague criterion and replace it with one an evaluator can check.
assertions: Does not keep make it nice as the criterion
Rewrites it into a testable statement
